title: Phase 2：序列關係挖掘第二個結果：A336482 = A102712 的差分（組合的左到右極大值與最大部分），並證明 A119706 的 Mathar 猜想

A336482.proof: paper proof by g.f., refined for each j: B_j(n) = A_j(n) - A_j(n-1); checked by brute force n <= 18 and DP n < 80. No Lean. Also follows from the g.f. of A382312 (Rascoe 2025): d/dy at y=1 gives (1-x) times Jovovic g.f. of A102712.

A119706.proof: bijection binary words of length n <-> compositions of n+1; longest run k <-> largest part k+1. No Lean. Also follows in one step from the g.f.s already in A102712 (Jovovic) and A119706 (Balado 2025).

novelty.note: Neither statement is written in the OEIS, but both follow in one step from g.f.s already in the entries (A382312 for A336482; A102712 and A119706 for Mathar's conjecture). Exercise level; per section 1c these are not qualifying L1 candidates.
